Iron Deficiency (Anemia).dietary_notes: Combine plant-based iron (non-heme) with Vitamin C rich foods like oranges or sweet potatoes to boost absorption by up to 300%. Avoid tea or coffee with iron-rich meals.
supplements: Ferrous Sulfate (65mg elemental iron daily with Vit C)

Vitamin D Deficiency.dietary_notes: Vitamin D is fat-soluble. Consume with healthy fats like olive oil, avocado, or nuts to optimize intestinal absorption.
supplements: Vitamin D3 (2000-5000 IU daily taken with meals)

Vitamin B12 Deficiency.dietary_notes: Essential for nerve function and RBC formation. Plant-based individuals must consume fortified plant milks, nutritional yeast, or sublingual B12.

Calcium Deficiency.dietary_notes: Crucial for bone density and muscle contractions. Pair with Vitamin D for optimal bone deposition.
supplements: Calcium Citrate (500mg twice daily with meals)

Folate (Vitamin B9) Deficiency.dietary_notes: Key for cellular synthesis and neural tube prevention. Steam greens lightly to prevent thermal destruction of folate.

Zinc Deficiency.dietary_notes: Supports immune defenses and taste integrity. Soak seeds and legumes to neutralize phytates that bind zinc.
supplements: Zinc Picolinate or Gluconate (15-30 mg daily)

Vitamin A Deficiency.dietary_notes: Vital for vision, immunity, and skin barrier health. Beta-carotene in sweet potato converts to active Retinol in body.
supplements: Cod Liver Oil or Vitamin A Palmitate (5000 IU daily)

Vitamin C Deficiency.dietary_notes: Powerful antioxidant supporting collagen synthesis and iron uptake. Heat degrades Vit C, so consume fresh fruits raw.
supplements: Ascorbic Acid or Liposomal Vitamin C (500-1000 mg daily)

Magnesium Deficiency.dietary_notes: Regulates muscle relaxation, mood, and over 300 enzymatic pathways. High stress increases magnesium excretion.
supplements: Magnesium Glycinate or Citrate (300-400 mg at night)

Iodine Deficiency.dietary_notes: Essential for thyroid hormone production (T3/T4) and metabolic regulation. Use iodized salt or sea vegetables.
